answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region, which matches the March regional degradation more closely than a global bad-build error spike. Failover is the one action that can restore availability in-region-scope while keeping customer writes flowing if the shift is clean. The recent release and daily settlement peak remain plausible confounders (staged primary canary vs load), so this is not certain; circuit breaking is rejected because it would shed writes, and read-replica routing does not address the write path. Flagging downstream settlement/write risk because we would move peak settlement writes across regions.
